title: An iid FPP law with proved KPZ exponent relation
exact_statement: Question 22 asks for a passage-time distribution where chi = 2 xi - 1 holds in ordinary FPP. The surrounding discussion says existence and appropriate definition of these exponents are part of the problem. A candidate proof must name one fixed iid law and establish the exponents it uses; the question does not prescribe numerical exponent values or a unique formal convention.
primary_source_quote: Question 22. Find a distribution of passage times where (4.13) holds.
conditional_theorem_note: Chatterjee proves chi = 2 xi - 1 assuming the strong exponents exist; those exponents are not known to exist for any iid law in the 2016 survey.
